parts.text:
The value l is the length of the spring when the load L is 0.0 N.
Measure the unstretched length l of the spring. Do not include the loops at the ends of
the spring in your measurement.
Record l in cm to the nearest mm in Table 1.1.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text: Draw a diagram of the spring to show clearly the length l of the spring.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
• Suspend a load L = 1.0 N from the spring.
• Record the new length l of the spring in Table 1.1.
• Calculate the extension e of the spring using the equation e = (l – l ).
• Record the value of e in Table 1.1.
• Repeat the procedure using loads L = 2.0 N, 3.0 N, 4.0 N and 5.0 N.
• Record all the readings and results in Table 1.1.
